title: Evaluating higher-order product formulae for molecular ground-state energy estimation
summary: We evaluate deterministic higher-order product formulae for molecular ground-state energy estimation. Motivated by recent fault-tolerant architectures in which non-Clifford operations may be generated more locally and cheaply than in conventional assumptions, we re-examine such formulae as practical candidates for quantum chemistry. Using one-dimensional hydrogen chains from $\mathrm{H}_2$ to $\mathrm{H}_{15}$ as benchmarks, we estimate both the total gate count and the depth of $R_Z$-rotation layers required to reach a target energy error.
